name: hba-uigen
description: HBA prototype library browser: scan the workspace project into a module/page tree (dirs = modules, html/jsx/tsx/vue = pages), browse single pages, cite them into the conversation, and manage the skill library.

description_i18n.en: HBA prototype library panel: the panel is bound to the current workspace project and scans it into a module/page tree (directories are modules, html/jsx/tsx/vue files are pages), browse and edit single pages on disk, cite pages into the conversation, plus a seeded skill library (list/get/save/delete skills).
description_i18n.zh-CN: HBA 原型库面板：面板绑定当前工作区（项目），扫描项目目录建树（目录=模块、html/jsx/tsx/vue 文件=页面），单页浏览与磁盘读写、引用到会话，附带技能库（播种/列表/读取/保存/删除技能）。
